title: Chapter 397 Fighting General
content:
Chapter 397 Fighting General

Up to now, 5,000 troops have left Shangqiu City, and not far from him, there are 80,000 troops waiting for them with open mouths, and they will retreat if they can.

I am afraid that as soon as the order to retreat from the Demon King of Huangshan comes, the 5,000 army will collapse in an instant. Even with his majestic restraint as the Demon King, it will have little effect.

The strength gap between the two sides is really too big.

A power gap of more than ten times is enough to make any army feel hopeless, so that they can't afford to resist in their hearts, and they will be captured without a fight.

"The only way to survive now is to deceive the soldiers who are not very strong, and drag them to follow me.

When the time comes, let them entangle for a while to disrupt the enemy's position, and then find an opportunity to break the deadlock and escape. "

While rolling his eyes, the Demon King of Huangshan came up with such a poisonous plan to abandon his soldiers and seek a way out for himself.

The 5,000 demon soldiers continued to mobilize the army, slowly pressing forward. Not long, that is, ten minutes, it was already within ten miles of the town.

After a while, it was already approaching five miles.

At this range, these demon soldiers have already seen the main outline of the town, and the earth walls of the surrounding houses are clearly visible.

Sitting among the crowd of 36 burly demons, the Demon King of Huangshan raised his right hand to signal the army to stop and line up on the spot.

The 5,000 demon soldiers under his command moved quickly, but within a short time, they had already arranged a rather neat army formation, and their breaths were implicated with each other, forming a killing formation as soon as they arrived on the battlefield.

"As expected of a battle-tested veteran, among other things, this marching formation is quite strict, and orders and prohibitions are also commendable."

On the opposite side of the Demon King of Huangshan, at a distance of five miles, Zhong Yu stood on a low earthen wall, surrounded by several guards. Seeing the command of the Demon King of Huangshan, those demon soldiers were so strict that he could not help but utter sigh.

Although the number of these demon soldiers is small, they are worthy of their experience in the past six months. After several conquests with the regular army of the Ming Dynasty, they have grown up, and they can barely be called elites.

On the battlefield, swords and guns have no eyes, and fighting against each other is even more tragic. Which one of the characters who can survive is not powerful, and has a certain amount of luck, so he can be called the best wherever he is placed.

It is quite rare for these 5000 demon soldiers to be majestic from this.

After all, the Yaozu has congenital defects. Although they are physically strong, it is quite difficult to develop their intelligence.

After the death of the third-order monster race, the intelligence is only like that of a six-year-old child. They are not useful at all, and they can only barely understand a few commands.

But now, looking at the monster army on the opposite side, they can understand complex orders and retreat with each other. It is obvious that they have undergone certain training to have such a grand scene.

It is not easy to do this, at least the intelligence of a child over ten years old is required.

"What should I say? Should I say, 'Are you worthy of being a demon king who was born with the luck of the demon clan?'"

Zhong Yu touched his lips, thinking so in his heart.

As the first test made by the demon way that has been eroding humanity for 300 years, the quality of the army under the command of the Demon King of Huangshan can be said to be extremely luxurious, even the troops under the command of some seventh-rank demon kings can't compare.

However, his mission ended there.

In the world of Liaozhai where Zhong Yu appeared, the trajectory of fate will definitely not be the same as before.

The great prosperity of the demon way will be interrupted, the human way will be tamed by him, the hearing will be completely lost, this world will be in the hands of Zhong Yu, and it will become the food for his growth.

"Send the order, the First Legion is out."

Zhong Yu waved his hand, and behind him a man dressed as a general saluted and said goodbye, and then there was a lot of noise in the town.

Not long after, an army of 10,000 people drove out of the main gate, and began to line up three miles away from the opposite army.

"I am under the command of the Great Imperial Empire, directly under the commander of the First Army of the Forbidden Army, General Longxiang Chen Wu, who dares to come and fight with me."

When the army was setting up the formation, a figure on a horse came out of the formation and quickly came to the front of the formation of the two armies.

In this world where the personal force is extraordinary and the impact on the war is extremely strong, Zhong Yu's army has also restored the battlefield situation of fighting generals.

After all, gaining great prestige by beheading the opponent's generals under one's own command can not only improve the morale of one's own side, but also severely hit the opponent's will to fight and speed up the disintegration of the enemy's army.

Just as Chen Wu was riding a steed under his crotch and was constantly marching around to demonstrate, there was a commotion in the monster army on the opposite side, and there were voices of discussion, and the formation was a bit chaotic for a while.

After all, it is a monster clan, even if its intelligence is better than that of an ordinary monster clan, it is still unbearable for the monster clan who respects the strong to face such a blatant provocation.

After several fluctuations, under the advice of a mighty and majestic general who has almost turned into a human form, except for a black tail at the end that still retains the shape of a beast, other than that, the Huangshan demon Wang nodded and signaled him to fight.

The general got a response, his face was full of joy, he got down directly, his body jumped, and appeared in the middle of the battlefield in a puff of smoke.

"Humans who are in a hurry to die, don't worry, your second grandfather wolf is here. I will definitely not kill you so quickly later, seeing that you are strong and muscular, there must be such a chewing head, I want to enjoy it..."

Before he finished talking about demonization, he saw a huge figure rushing towards him at a speed as fast as lightning. Before he could react, a bright silver figure rushed towards his face.

Pooh!

There was a muffled sound, and then blood splattered everywhere, and drops of stinky blood splashed on the ground.

In the demon king's widened mouth, a white gun shadow passed through, pierced its throat, and pierced through the back of its head. Pulled out.

The surrounding area was extremely silent.

Especially on the side of the monsters, no one expected that General Wolf, who was usually quite prestigious in their army and ranked in the top ten in strength, would die like this. He didn't even survive a single move.

This is really demoralizing.

On the other hand, the imperial army on the other side recalled the applause from the whole world.

"Wan Sheng!"

"Wan Sheng!"

"Wan Sheng!"

After three rounds of applause, the army returned to silence again, turning into a fighting spirit that was so quiet that it killed people.

This kind of depression made the demon soldiers on the opposite side start to feel a little panicked, and their positions became chaotic.

"Who else dares to fight?"

Chen Wu urged his horse forward again, and shouted at the goblin opposite him.

All of a sudden, his white figure was so chic that countless people were fascinated by it.
